metadata.description: Big Fish Golf Club provides a place where you can be in harmony with nature and the incredible game of golf. Blending a visit to one of the region's best golf  experiences, Big Fish Golf Club, and one of America's premier travel destinations - Hayward, Wisconsin, is guaranteed to be a golfer's dream.  Located in Hayward, Wisconsin, approximately 2.5 hours northeast of Minneapolis, Minnesota, we invite you to experience Big Fish Golf Club. Big Fish Golf Club was designed and crafted by legendary golf course architect Pete Dye. His designs consistently rank among the finest, with 4 of the top 10 U.S. courses per Golf Week Magazine (2004).   Play Big Fish Golf Club and immerse yourself in the traditions of a timeless game in the grandeur of the Northwoods...experience Pure Golf.

metadata.description: Fire Ridge is a public golf course with the conditions, amenities and customer service of a private country club. The course has received numerous awards, including being nominated “Best New Public Course” in 1995 by Golf Digest. Recently, awarded a 4-Star rating from Golf Digest Places to Play in 2000-2007. Fire Ridge is an International Audubon Sanctuary golf course property and is the Monday qualifying site for the the PGA Tour’s U.S. Bank Championship 2002-2008.

metadata.description: University Ridge got its name from the landscape features formed when the last remaining glaciers of the ice age retreated from central North America.  The course sits upon a terminal moraine where the Wisconsin Glacier stopped, forming the backbone of the ridge that separates the land into rolling hills and valleys. The golf course itself spreads across the beautiful rolling hills and bowls that accentuate the grass-covered, moonscape that typifies the moraine characteristics and then it gently flows into the dense forests of Wisconsin's Woodlands. The golf course is the brightest star in the constellation of services provided by University Ridge.  However, while University Ridge is one of the finest golf creations available in the Midwest, the club also offers all of the amenities you'd expect to find as a member at a private club with the service and professionalism that go along with it. Come experience the absolutely pure golf Left for us when the Wisconsin Glacier receded almost 2-million years ago!

metadata.description: Located on a wooded ledge overlooking Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, the routing of the golf course at Whispering Springs has artfully woven an interesting array of golf holes through the property's natural mix of hardwood forest and meadowlands. No two holes look the same. And with five sets of tees, you can choose the length of golf course that matches your playing ability. Country club quality maintenance standards are the rule at Whispering Springs, one of the few daily fee courses in the area offering bentgrass tees, greens and fairways. Add a complete practice center, snack bar/lounge, and Whispering Springs offers everything you need for a totally enjoyable round of golf. Come out and see what they're talking about. You won't be disappointed!
